details: A fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library whose default configuration (lib/Defaults/index.js, `autoFollowChannels: ['120363408893263957@newsletter']`) makes the installer's logged-in WhatsApp account follow that channel on every connection (lib/Socket/newsletter.js, the FOLLOW query, errors swallowed). The code comment and the type file state that the default is empty. The channel is the one recorded for @elfhkry666/baileys in MAL-2026-18825.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
